# Dr. Trevor Kouritzin

> Clinical nutrition researcher, Ph.D. in Medicine (Preventive Medicine), M.Sc. in Human Nutrition, B.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, supplement formulation specialist, and IFBB Pro bodybuilder based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

Dr. Trevor Kouritzin translates peer-reviewed medical, nutritional, and biochemical evidence into actionable clinical and athletic performance strategies. When direct clinical evidence is lacking, he advocates for structured behavioral framework models to guide decision-making.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://trevorkouritzin.com/): Executive overview, methodology, featured research articles, and peer-reviewed publications.
- [Meet Dr. Trevor](https://trevorkouritzin.com/meet-trevor): Academic credentials, competitive athletic background, and speaking formats.
- [Services](https://trevorkouritzin.com/services): 1-Hour Zoom Consultation ($200) — personalized 60-minute strategy session.
- [Evidence-Based Articles](https://trevorkouritzin.com/articles): Searchable research breakdowns with PubMed & DOI citations plus an interactive Human Equivalent Dose (HED) calculator.
- [Peer-Reviewed Publications](https://trevorkouritzin.com/publications): Published journal articles and conference proceedings with BibTeX/APA citation export.
- [Contact & Speaking](https://trevorkouritzin.com/contact): Direct consulting inquiries, academic/industry speaking requests, and newsletter subscription.
